calls.title: Kim Li and Ashley Stirrup + Scott Keller
calls.summary: GrowthBook's Ashley Stirrup, Scott Keller, and solutions engineer Logan Bates demonstrated their experimentation and feature flagging platform to Kim Li, Senior Manager for Online Experimentation at Home Depot. They highlighted AI-driven workflows, a visual editor, Contentful integration, and warehouse-native analytics as solutions to Home Depot's pain points with Adobe Target (cost, reliability, lack of innovation). Next steps: Kim will gather internal partners for a larger demo/lunch and learn; Scott will send documentation on Contentful and server-side SDKs plus a meeting follow
